title: Cauchy–Schwarz for the uniform expectation
statement:
Let $g, h : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be Boolean functions, and let $\E[\,\cdot\,]$ denote the
expectation under the uniform measure on the hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$. Then
\[
  \bigl(\E[g^2 h^2]\bigr)^2 \;\le\; \E[g^4]\cdot\E[h^4].
\]
hypotheses_covered: g is a Boolean function of arity n
h is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced: For Boolean functions $g, h$ on the cube, $\bigl(\E[g^2 h^2]\bigr)^2 \le \E[g^4]\cdot\E[h^4]$.
